bullets.text: Cyclonic storm Murasu has triggered heavy rainfall and a red alert across Chennai and Thiruvallur, with police issuing high sea wave warnings in Pulicat.
Road cave-ins caused by pipeline damage and metro work disrupted traffic on Velachery Main Road, requiring close monitoring by local authorities.
The IMD issued an orange alert for north Tamil Nadu districts as Cyclone Murasu approaches, and 30 NDRF personnel were dispatched to Thiruvallur.
Pelican birds resting on high-voltage transmission towers in the Pallikaranai marshland are frequently dying due to accidental electrocution.
A motorcyclist died after a lorry collision near Polivakkam, highlighting ongoing road safety concerns in Uthukottai.
Residents protested against the construction of a sewage drainage pipeline from multi-storey apartments in Ayanampakkam within the Thirumazhisai municipality.
Nelcast is expanding its Ponneri plant capacity to 60,000 TPA by January 2027, currently awaiting a power supply upgrade for new furnaces.
L&T's Vyoma.AI has begun construction of a 52 MW AI data centre in Chennai, reinforcing the city's position as a digital hub.
Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercompute cluster in Chennai and announced plans to scale Indian AI compute capacity to 1 GW by 2029.
MeitY launched the DEPA handbook to support safe data sharing for AI training, providing a framework the ministry should monitor for compliance.
Residents of Venkatapuram Pudhukalani thanked the government for resolving a 15-year-old power cable issue.
AAVIN invited applications from interested individuals to run new milk booths in Chennai, with a submission deadline of November 16.
